name: Greater Enemy Cover
body:
You are skilled at using your opponents for cover.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Improved Enemy Cover, base attack bonus +6, Int 13.

Benefit(s): You receive a +2 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Bonus when performing this combat maneuver against a foe. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by Improved Enemy Cover. You gain an addition 10’ of movement when using this feet as you allow your opponents momentum to move your forward.
